Name: Controller Radial Keybindings
Author: spacechase0
Description:
Set keybindings to trigger from a radial menu with your controller. Press the trigger keybinding to open the radial menu, select a slice with your control stick to pick a keybinding, and then release the trigger keybinding to execute it.

There are two radial menus that can be configured separately.

For keybindings activated by the radial menu, you can also set them to be pressed for a set amount of time.

NOTE: This mod comes unconfigured! You need to go in Generic Mod Config Menu and configure it to which buttons you want to open the radial menu, and which buttons the radial menu should triggers. (It only supports mod keybindings at the moment - only supports keybindings registered with GMCM.)

Only controllers are supported. While you can configure the radial menu to open via keyboard, the mouse does not work on it.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]..
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
